title: tragopogon brevirostris subsp. volgensis
intro: Tragopogon brevirostris subsp. volgensis, commonly known as the salsify or goat's beard, is a plant species in the sunflower family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to treat digestive issues and act as a natural laxative. The therapeutic actions of T. brevirostris subsp. volgensis include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been found to exhibit antimicrobial and anticancer properties.
